page_title: BOL 3-0 SAL | Bologna v Salernitana 01/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+2' 3 - 0 Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Alexis Saelemaekers. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom right corner via the woodwork. 3:0!
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The ball is cleared after Dan Ndoye (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
89' The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
88' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
87' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Junior Sambia (Salernitana) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
83' Here is a change. Stefan Posch is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
83' Konstantinos Manolas comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jerome Boateng (Salernitana).
83' The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
82' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Federico Ravaglia.
78' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
77' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lewis Ferguson as he is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
74' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Remo Freuler is replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
73' The ball is cleared after Junior Sambia (Salernitana) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing.
66' Joshua Zirkzee slides a brilliant pass into Dan Ndoye (Bologna), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) coming on for Marco Pellegrino.
66' Stefano Colantuono decides to make a substitution. Toma Basic will be replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
64' The game is interrupted now, Toma Basic (Salernitana) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riccardo Orsolini leaves the pitch and Dan Ndoye (Bologna) comes on.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) comes onto the pitch for Jens Odgaard.
60' Substitution. Junior Sambia (Salernitana) on for Niccolo Pierozzi.
60' Stefano Colantuono has decided to make a change. Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) replaces Giulio Maggiore.
59' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
59' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
56' A goal, which was scored by Jens Odgaard (Bologna), was disallowed due to offside.
53' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
52' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
50' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
47' Stefan Posch received a sweet pass from Michel Aebischer (Bologna), but the advance is stopped.
46' Referee Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A cross by Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
45+1' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' 2 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top right corner of the net.

41' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
41' A cross into the box from Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is cleared.
40' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
37' Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Wow, what an escape. Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
35' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
34' The linesman makes the right call and Bologna will have a corner.
32' Handball! A player from Bologna handled the ball. Salernitana are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
32' 77:23 – the ratio of ball possession.
31' The foul by Jens Odgaard (Bologna) was seen by Ermano Feliciani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
31' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
29' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
28' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
27' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
26' Bologna will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
26' Referee Ermano Feliciani sees the trip by Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
24' A lofted cross from Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
23' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is caught offside!
22' Toma Basic (Salernitana) is able to continue to play.
20' Toma Basic (Salernitana) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Salernitana.
17' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

17' Simy (Salernitana) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Federico Ravaglia inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
16' Remo Freuler (Bologna) produces a killer pass onto Michel Aebischer, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.

14' 1 - 0 Riccardo Calafiori sends a lovely ball into Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). He latches on to it and shoots inside the left post from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
13' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
10' A pass from Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) is intercepted by Benoit Costil and the move breaks down.
7' Remo Freuler (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Alexis Saelemaekers picks out Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
4' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
2' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Salernitana will kick the game off.
